overview.description: The Tradr 2X Long PONY Daily ETF (PONX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund provides 2x exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement of Pony.ai stock (NASDAQ: PONY). Pony.ai is an autonomous vehicle company that develops driving technology enabling vehicles to operate using artificial intelligence and machine learning. PONX was launched on Sep 8, 2025 and is issued by Tradr.
